docs.title: Rail Works Universe Wiki
docs.text:
Welcome to the wiki for Rail Works Universe (RWU), a railway game on Roblox. You can drive trains for four companies, work as a conductor, signaler, dispatcher, station staff or maintenance, or ride as a passenger.

Stations 55 with 130 platforms Routes 47 Trains 6 classes in 126 combinations of company, livery and length Track about 188 miles Signals 979 Sets of points 697

  • Live map

    Who is playing right now and which train they are on.

  • Network map

    The line map: click any station to open its page.

  • Stations

    Every station with its platforms and the routes that call there.

  • Routes

    All 47 routes, stop by stop, in both directions.

  • Trains

    The six classes, their sizes and liveries.

  • Companies

    MetroLink, Express, JetRail and Coastline.

  • Jobs

    The six jobs and their ranks.

The station, route and train pages are generated from the game's own data (last export: 2026-11-13). See About this wiki for how to edit it.

docs.title: About this wiki
docs.text: This is the wiki for Rail Works Universe (RWU), a railway game on Roblox.

docs.title: Where the pages come from
docs.text:
• The station, route, train, company and job pages are generated from an export of the game's own data (data/export.json). Do not edit them by hand: they are rewritten whenever the export is refreshed. To rebuild them run python3 build_pages.py.
  • The guides and this page are written by hand, in docs/guides/ and docs/about.md.
  • The network map and the live map use the line map picture with docs/assets/schematic-data.json, which the same script writes from data/schematic.json.

docs.title: Editing
docs.text: Every page has an edit button at the top right that opens it on GitHub. Guides are the best place to help: write only what you have checked in the game.

docs.title: Building the site
docs.text:

pip install mkdocs-material
python3 build_pages.py
mkdocs serve

docs.title: Driving a route
docs.text: This is how the Train Operator's Drive menu works.

docs.title: Picking a train and a route
docs.text:
1. Open the Drive menu and pick a company: MetroLink, Express, JetRail or Coastline.
  2. Pick a train: first the class, then the livery, then how many cars.
  3. Pick a route, then the station to start from.
  4. Pick the yard the train comes out of. The nearest yard to your station is listed first.
  5. Pick how the route is run: Regular (all stops), Rapid (every other stop) or Express (major stations only).

All trains and all routes are open to every player. The HST also needs the Qualified Operator rank (300 Operator XP).

docs.title: Out on the line
docs.text:
1. The train comes out of the yard with you in the cab, not in service, and you drive it empty to your starting station.
  2. Stopping there earns XP and you are asked whether to start the route.
  3. The train then works the route towards the far end, stopping at the stations for the type you picked. The doors open and close by themselves and the starting signal clears by itself.
  4. At the last station you get the XP for the service and are asked whether to continue back the other way. At a terminus you change ends once the doors are closed.
  5. If you leave the cab while out on the line, or end your duty, the train is removed.

docs.title: Long trains at short platforms
docs.text: A train that is longer than a platform stops with its front at the far end of the platform. Only the doors of the cars that are alongside the platform open. See the train pages for the length of each formation and the station pages for platform lengths.

docs.title: Jobs
docs.text:
There are 6 jobs. Each has its own XP and five ranks; the top two ranks are awarded by staff.

Job What you do Train Operator Drive passenger trains: take a service, prepare the train, stop at every station and keep to time. Conductor Ride a passenger train: open the doors on the platform side, manage boarding and tell the operator when it is ready to depart. Signaler Run a signal box: set routes, move points and keep trains safely apart on the live track diagram. Dispatcher Work one station's platforms: send Train Ready To Start, close the doors and give each train the Right Away when its signal is clear. Station Staff Keep the stations clean: pick up litter, mop spills, empty the bins and take the trash out, then ride a train to the next station that needs you. Maintenance Take maintenance trains out to faulty signals, track and platforms, protect the work area and make repairs.
